decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day-patient program is tightly aligned with the firm's mental-health services and its own dedicated page signals visible investment and commitment, which management would be reluctant to reverse after only one year.

The carpentry workshop fits the firm's practical therapy and production capabilities, and a standalone web presence suggests sunk investment and public commitment that favor continuation despite any early uncertainty.

Outpatient sociotherapy is very close to the firm's established support model, so management would tend to continue it and attribute any modest early traction to a normal ramp-up rather than abandon it quickly.

The counseling service for senior living sits near the core eldercare business and its placement on the home page indicates especially visible commitment, making withdrawal unlikely under an escalation-of-commitment logic.

The retail shop extends the sheltered-workshop activity into market-facing form and, even if still small, management would likely preserve it because it builds on existing structures and can be justified as needing more time.
